heading: Cost sharing for Territories and Indian tribes

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary shall waive local cost-sharing requirements up to $200,000 for all studies and projects—

children.text: in American Samoa, Guam, the Northern Mariana Islands, the Virgin Islands, Puerto Rico, and the Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands;
for any Indian tribe or tribal organization (as those terms are defined in section 5304 of title 25); and
is composed primarily of people who are—
recognized and defined under Federal law as indigenous people of the United States; and
assists in the social, cultural, and educational development of such people in that community.

tree.heading: Inflation adjustment
tree.text: The Secretary shall adjust the dollar amount specified in subsection (a) on an annual basis for inflation.

tree.heading: Inclusion
tree.text: For purposes of this section, the term “study” includes a watershed assessment.

tree.heading: Application
tree.text: The Secretary shall apply the waiver amount described in subsection (a) to reduce only the non-Federal share of study and project costs.
